finding: Reproducible public-data work must preserve query, retrieval time, version or vintage, pagination behavior, transformations, and content identity.
Reliable agent evaluation needs task-shaped cases, deterministic checks where possible, independent judgment where necessary, and recorded outcome evidence.
Selecting strategies from many backtests creates an overfitting risk, so trading graders must test time order, robustness, and selection bias rather than reward headline return alone.
Long-run reliability improves when bounded failures are injected against a defined steady state and recovery is measured and recorded.
Autonomous routing should add complexity only when measured outcomes justify it and should retain observable guardrails and stopping conditions.
